title: DIO/ODI MCP: Read-only Model Context Protocol Server for the DIO/ODI Reference Model and Agentic Entity Resolution Mappings
description:
DIO/ODI MCP is a public, stateless, read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes a versioned snapshot of the DIO/ODI Reference Model and selected derived application mappings for Agentic Entity Resolution (Agentic ER). It is designed to let an MCP client retrieve canonical concepts, reconstruction-failure diagnostics, mutation-specific guardrail profiles, evidence-promotion and commit-boundary contracts, and Policy-as-Code integration requirements.
The primary integration use case is an Agentic ER application requesting a bounded diagnostic profile for an action class and mutation type, then using the returned illustrative mappings as inputs to its own domain policy and local Supervisor. The Worker does not inspect application state or execute authorization decisions.
The service bundles 40 canonical concepts, the four-domain/eight-mode Reconstruction Failure taxonomy, bounded Agentic ER mapping extracts, evidence-promotion and commit-boundary contracts, and a Policy-as-Code mapping. It exposes ten tools, seven read-only resources, and one integration-planning prompt over Streamable HTTP. The deployed service runs as a Cloudflare Worker and is stateless.
The implementation is deliberately limited to a read-only Phase 1 MCP service. It is not an MVDIO Supervisor or authorization service: it does not read application graphs or evidence stores, derive a production mutation hypothesis, execute admission/claim/graph-constraint checks, issue authorization tokens, authorize Phase 1 or Phase 2, commit or revert writes, or control the full hypothesis-conditioned evidence loop. Returned constraint bindings are illustrative and are not universal domain policies.
The bundled Reference Model archive is v0.9.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24085589), with Reference Vocabulary v0.2.2, Agentic ER mapping v0.3.1, and a separately identified live Semantic Change Feed snapshot. The archived Reference Model and the live feed are distinct versioned states.
Licensing is intentionally split: the software implementation in this repository is MIT-licensed; reproduced or adapted DIO/ODI reference content and mapping data are licensed CC BY 4.0 and attributed in data/ATTRIBUTION.md. Third-party dependencies retain their own licenses. The MIT metadata license applies to the software record and does not relicense embedded CC BY 4.0 material.
